title: Pip and the Frog in the Rain

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing on a flat fallen log beside a compost heap.
Raindrops falling steadily onto the flat log, small puddles forming.
Pip the sparrow flying into a dry gap under the edge of the compost heap, folding his wings.
A small green frog already sitting in the same dry gap, turning to look at Pip.
Pip the sparrow and the small green frog sitting side by side in the dry gap, rain still falling outside.
Pip the sparrow and the frog both settled and still, watching the rain from the dry gap.
The rain easing outside the gap, drops falling more lightly now.
Pip the sparrow and the frog stepping out of the gap into fresh sunshine.
Pip the sparrow and the small green frog sitting together happily on the dry log in the sun.
